title: Nick Sirianni, Jalen Hurts seems to disagree on the management of Philly's final drive

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Nick Sirianni, Jalen Hurts seems to disagree on the management of Philly's final drive
sources.description: On Sunday, Eagles coach Nick Sirianni willingly took blame for the decision to put the kickoff in play with eight seconds left and a one-point lead over Jacksonville.
